final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry line by line, extracting only ERROR and CRITICAL level entries (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC in the required format. Extracted the service, level (uppercased), message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). Counted repeated entries from the "-- last message repeated N times --" lines following each entry. Summed repeat counts by service. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
